caption: The drawing depicts a single, round, symmetrical object resembling an ornate medallion or disk, rendered primarily in a brownish-red color. The object has a scalloped edge composed of outwardly projecting semi-circular forms, each with a textured surface, arranged evenly around the circumference. Inside the scalloped edge is an inner border encircling a central area filled with intricate openwork patterns. The central motif consists of four swirling, curved, leaf-like shapes arranged in a pinwheel or swastika pattern around a small circular center, with each shape connecting at their tips. Surrounding this motif are further open, looping shapes and circular holes, forming an interlocking, symmetrical pattern. The shapes and cutouts are handled with a sense of depth, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance. Beneath the object, on the off-white background, the name "A. L. DAVISON II" is printed in small, uppercase letters.
title: Trivet
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
